original_prompt.global_prompt: Maintain the same man and room across four five-second shots: a lowered gaze lifts, his arms fold, he glances sideways with arms crossed, then makes small mouth movements and leans forward.

shots.text: In a dim, warmly lit room, the Bearded man sits back on the Beige sofa, arms resting low. He has medium-brown skin, short curly black hair, a thick beard and mustache, and a faded blue-gray T-shirt with small outlined chest lettering. Hold a medium view with him left of center, a wooden doorway softly visible behind him and a dark blurred shape at the right foreground edge. Over five seconds, he lifts his lowered gaze toward screen right while keeping his torso relaxed and his mouth closed.

A closer oblique view of the Bearded man on the same Beige sofa shows his curly hair, full beard and blue-gray shirt against softly blurred warm wood tones. During five seconds, he makes a brief small mouth movement, lowers his gaze, tilts his head and upper body slightly, and folds his arms across his chest. He settles back with his lips closed and arms still crossed.

Back in the medium view of the same warm, pale-walled room, the Bearded man sits against the Beige sofa with his arms firmly crossed over his blue-gray shirt. The wooden doorway remains behind him and the blurred dark shape stays at the right foreground edge. Over five seconds, he opens his initially lowered eyes, glances toward screen left, then returns his gaze toward the front and slightly right. Keep his seated posture and folded arms steady.

The Bearded man remains on the same Beige sofa in the dim warm room, seen close from the oblique angle with the rounded sofa back and dark wooden background softly blurred. Start with his arms crossed and gaze lowered. Across five seconds he raises his chin slightly and makes small, nonspecific mouth movements, then leans his head and upper torso forward near the end. End during this forward lean.
